社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
papers.authors: Shuwei Yuan, Mingqian Ding, Luxin Liu, Rong Xiao, Xiaoyi Zeng
papers.abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly display clickable query suggestions alongside items in the user feed, enabling users to refine or expand their intent without manually reformulating queries. Existing approaches either mine suggestions from historical logs -- limited to past behavior and blind to long-tail, personalized intents -- or rely on off-the-shelf LLMs whose lack of platform-specific knowledge yields fluent but generic queries disconnected from real click behavior. We propose EAGER (Enrich-and-AliGn gEnerative Query Recommendation), a two-stage framework for generating query suggestions from clicked items. In the enrichment stage, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) follows a four-stage curriculum that scales information richness (from item-only to user-conditioned) and reasoning depth (from direct to chain-of-thought). Each stage incorporates rationale augmentation, diversity regularization, and self-distillation. In the alignment stage, we post-train via GRPO with a hybrid reward of multiple rule-based business signals and a preference-aware click reward. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B test demonstrate the effectiveness of EAGER, which has been deployed in production at a major e-commerce platform.
papers.summary: EAGER面向用户点击商品后返回推荐流的场景，根据商品属性和用户行为生成搜索建议。方法先通过四阶段课程学习、多样性正则与自蒸馏扩展意图，再用规则及点击偏好混合奖励进行GRPO对齐。阿里团队在5%流量上开展9天实验，PCTR提高1.28%，支付订单数提高3.49%，L2P提高2.38%。
papers.key_insight: 同一个点击奖励模型同时筛选监督标签和指导强化学习，使候选扩展与线上偏好保持一致。消融显示GRPO主要改善规则合规，而用户上下文贡献最大的相关性增益。社区UGC可试验“读帖后推荐搜索词”的独立召回通道，继续由现有排序器统一筛选，并用nDCG、CTR及后续有效阅读验证迁移收益。
